issues.detail: Hebrew 'כִּי מָֽלְאָה צְבָאָהּ' means 'her warfare is completed' or 'her time of service is fulfilled' (referring to the period of exile/service being complete), not 'Chiến tranh của nó đã chấm dứt' ('her war has ended'). The Hebrew word צָבָא here means 'warfare/service/appointed time' (as in Job 7:1, Isaiah 40:2), not 'war' in the sense of armed conflict. The Vietnamese rendering changes the meaning from the completion of her appointed service to the cessation of war.
